key_findings.finding: The compressed SELFIES decodes to C[C@@H]1CO[C@H]2Cn3cc(C(=O)NCc4ccc(F)cc4F)c(=O)c(OCc4ccccc4)c3C(=O)N12, a benzyl-protected hydroxyl-containing polycyclic imide/quinolone-like scaffold. Methanol with Pd/C effects catalytic hydrogenolytic debenzylation: the aryl-CH2-O substituent (OCH2Ph) is replaced by OH, while the rest of the scaffold and difluorobenzyl amide remain unchanged.

The major product is FC1=C(C=CC(=C1)F)CNC(=O)C=1C(C(=C2N(C[C@H]3N(C2=O)[C@@H](CO3)C)C1)O)=O, equivalently the same starting scaffold with OCH2Ph converted to phenolic/enolic OH. The database records report methanol solvent, Pd/C catalyst, and 86% yield.
